answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake assets to secure network roles. A game-theoretic multi-agent auditing protocol evaluates interactions: honest nodes inspect sparse topological cut verifications, driving malicious clusters to a financial ledge. When collusion is proven, automated stake slashing burns perpetrator funds. Like an onyx monolith fractured to reveal pure crystal, fake identities cannot scale because cross-cluster auditing imposes superlinear attacker costs.
